caption: The video captures an extreme close-up of a bearded man's face in bright side sunlight against a pale paneled wall. Strong shadows fall across the cheek and beard. A black ribbed cup device on a metal shaft is pressed to his right cheek at the left edge, drawing a patch of skin into a puckered dimple. His eyes stay wide open, and the nose and mouth remain prominent throughout. The lips reshape continuously, starting pursed together with only a small central gap, then parting wider to reveal the upper teeth and gums. The opening gradually rounds into a protruded 'O' pout with the lower lip pushed forward, while the left mouth corner stays pulled toward the cheek device. The metal shaft at the left edge moves slightly in and out of view.
relations: Pursed lips part to reveal upper teeth and gums, then gradually round into a protruded 'O' pout.
The left mouth corner remains pulled toward the black ribbed cup device on his right cheek.
The metal shaft attached to the device moves slightly in and out of the left frame edge.
